title: Search notes by a word
body:
## Problem
A writer cannot find an old note. They must read the full list.

## Acceptance criteria
1. `Notes.search(word)` returns each note that contains the word, in the order of `list()`.
2. The search ignores case: `search("Idea")` finds "an idea".
3. A word that no note contains gives an empty list.

## Non-goals
- No search in more than one word.
- No index or database.

## Test oracle
A unit test adds the notes "an idea", "milk", and "Idea two". It expects `search("idea")` to return `["1. an idea", "3. Idea two"]`, and `search("tea")` to return `[]`.

Personas: writer
